commands:
cat > .git/hooks/pre-commit << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# Pre-commit hook to run mypy type checking on Python files in src/

echo "Running mypy type checking on src/..."

# Find all Python files in src/
PYTHON_FILES=$(find src/ -name "*.py" -type f)

# Run mypy on the files
if [ -n "$PYTHON_FILES" ]; then
    mypy $PYTHON_FILES
    MYPY_EXIT_CODE=$?
else
    echo "No Python files found in src/"
    MYPY_EXIT_CODE=0
fi

# Block the commit if mypy fails
if [ $MYPY_EXIT_CODE -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "❌ mypy type checking failed. Commit blocked."
    exit 1
fi

echo "✓ mypy type checking passed."
exit 0
EOF
